name: Ring of Falling
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 1st; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of feather falling and operates as such, depending on the distance the wearer falls. If the fall is greater than 20′ there is a cumulative 5% chance per 20′ beyond the initial 20′ fall that the ring will cease functioning. Additionally, when the feather fall ability fails, the wearer falls at an increased speed, doubling the fall damage (up to the maximum of 20d6).

This ring can be removed freely.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of feather falling

Identification DC 26
False Identification DC 16
